racials.name: Axe Specialization
racials.forever: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and abilities by 1% while you have an axe or a two-handed axe equipped.

classic.name: Axe Specialization

racials.forever: Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.

classic.text: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Increases base melee attack power by 25% for 15 sec and reduces healing effects on you by 50% for 25 sec.

racials.forever: Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Using this ability in combat discourages enemies from attacking you, but increases the cooldown to 2 min.
